name: invariant-based-documentation-generator
description: Given a function, this extensions figures out specifications and writes an invariant-based documentation and relevant test cases

commands.title: Invariant-Based Documentation Generator: Set Provider API Key
Invariant-Based Documentation Generator: Clear Provider API Key

enumDescriptions: Ollama running locally (OpenAI-compatible, defaults to http://localhost:11434/v1)
invariant-based-documentation-generator..markdownDescription: Which LLM provider to use. OpenAI, Ollama, and LiteLLM all use the OpenAI-compatible API; set the matching `model` and, for Ollama/LiteLLM, the `baseURL` if it differs from the default.
The model name passed to the selected provider (e.g. `claude-opus-4-8`, `gpt-4o`, `llama3.1`). Must be a model the provider offers.

Optional base URL for the OpenAI-compatible providers (OpenAI / Ollama / LiteLLM). Leave empty to use the default for the selected provider — Ollama: `http://localhost:11434/v1`, LiteLLM: `https://ai-gateway.andrew.cmu.edu`. Ignored when the provider is Anthropic.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
